about: MaTecno's SEO layer: the CEO-approved wording of each page in every language (tools/empire_seo_apply.py writes it from Deliverables/marketing/matecno/seo/*.md; never edit by hand). `overrides` replaces a page's title, h1 and description in one language; `pages` are service pages of their own: `card` is the /servicos card they detail (its wording in each language is the body), `slugs` the address in each language. A language appears only with its approved wording (CEO 2026-10-09: every language the site serves).
